scientific_integrity: A self-contained classification of proper star edge colourings into oriented partial matchings, supplemented by exhaustive direct finite testing. The known minimum star chromatic index is not claimed as new. No independent external review has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only K_{2,n}; no uniform extension to larger complete bipartite factors, list colourings, or colourings modulo graph automorphisms. Equivalence under a less searchable name in earlier literature remains a priority risk.
title: Complete star-edge-colouring partition polynomial of \(K_{2,n}\)
